# Paul Irving & Twin Sailor

- [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — presumed Friend of — [Twin Sailor](../character/twin-sailor.md) — imaginary friends who come ashore to talk to him · since v2  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing her amusing experiences as a teacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She shares funny anecdotes about her students' responses in class and transcribes several composition letters written by her pupils, including an overly dramatic one from [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) copied from old love letters and an imaginative letter from [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) describing his fictional rock friends.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

> In his letter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) describes his imaginary rock friends at the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), and the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailor.md). He details a fantastical journey to the sunset in an enchanted boat with the oldest [Twin Sailor](../character/twin-sailor.md). He concludes his letter by clarifying to his teacher that the story isn't actually true.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies
